subject: Microgrant request: sandbox credits for overnight POC throughput check
messages:
From: Lina Park <lina@quantalo.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-03T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Quick ask: small sandbox grant for overnight throughput validation

Hi Camila,

Thanks again for the demo last week — it helped our infra team get comfortable with Redwood's routing behavior. We're preparing a short overnight POC to validate throughput and p95 latency at ~1,200 QPS for a subset of our inference pipeline.

Request: would Redwood provision a small, time-limited credit allocation (approx. equivalent to 500k tokens / 48 hours) so we can run our soak and collect telemetry? We plan to run from 00:00–08:00 PT next Wednesday (2026-09-09) to avoid customer traffic.

Acceptance criteria:
- sustained 1k–1.2k QPS for 3-hour window
- p95 < 200ms for typical 1k token prompts
- KV/cache warmup behavior observed across sequence lengths

Attached is our short test plan and estimated runbook. We'll capture traces and share a short post-run report. If you need any additional details (concurrency shape, model version, or target latency SLO), reply and I’ll send them.

Thanks,
Lina Park
Senior SRE, Quantalo
Attachment: quantalo_poc_plan.pdf (PDF, 220KB)
From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
To: Lina Park <lina@quantalo.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-03T09:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick ask: small sandbox grant for overnight throughput validation

Hi Lina —

Appreciate the clear runbook, and glad the demo was useful. We can usually accommodate short, targeted POCs like this via a microgrant. A couple quick clarifying Qs before I route for approval:

- Can you confirm the model you plan to hit (open or hosted variant) and max sequence length?
- Do you require a single-region run (us-west) or multi-region?
- If we provision the 48-hour allocation, would you like us to set up a temporary dashboard link and a one-time tracing hook to collect token-level latency?

If you’re ok with a single-region us-west run and the 500k-token equivalent, I’ll propose a 48-hour microgrant and loop in Marissa for sign-off. We typically attach a short promo approval letter and an allocation confirmation CSV for bookkeeping.

If you prefer a different window than next Wednesday, let me know — we can be flexible.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
